title_seed: 同一研究只能有一個 admission owner
central_problem: Terminal Manifest、Formal Architecture、Writer 與 QA 各自判斷 evidence eligibility 時，如何避免 split-brain truth？
reader_takeaway: consumer 可以投影 owner state，但不能重新授權或用自己的 count 取代 owner。

known_at_the_time.fact: current worktree contains canonical-study-admission.ts as the typed owner binding identity, access, facts, provenance and revision。
canonical admission QA recorded 46 study decisions with zero terminal/architecture/Writer projection mismatches。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: canonical decisions distinguish FORMAL, LIMITED, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN and access states; consumers validate identity/revision and project the same decision。

not_yet_available.fact: canonical substrate READY did not make content generalization READY; final Writer-validated/publishable LIMITED-or-better was 1/10 and FORMAL 0/10。

observed_failures.symptom: earlier layers disagreed on inclusive LIMITED/direct/formal counts and stale evidence revisions
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: multiple consumers reinterpreted normalized sources or reconstructed admission independently
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: the owner must be upstream of projections
observed_failures.later_resolution: canonical-study-admission became the single typed owner in the observed worktree

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The canonical admission substrate run recorded 46 decisions with 0 projection mismatches: 25 LIMITED, 21 BLOCKED and 0 FORMAL.
tests_and_metrics.result: canonical projection consistency passed; content generalization remained false

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 admission 放在 consumers 之前，要求 owner-issued evidence revision；mixed admitted/BLOCKED sets replan before Writer。

architecture_state.state: resolver/parser → canonical access state → canonical study admission → manifest/architecture/Writer/QA projections

safe_numbers.meaning: canonical decision totals in that run

safe_public_facts.fact: 當多個模組都能自己回答『這筆證據能不能用』，系統就可能同時產生多個互相矛盾的真相。

retrospective_notes.note: 這是 post-HEAD current worktree/QA evidence；沒有對應的 committed canonical admission commit。

publication_risks: 不要把 substrate READY 寫成 content READY。
不要公開 internal revision IDs 或完整 matrix。
